ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with a localized high-intensity (white) region near the central base; approximate macro-ratio of 12:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch at the lower central junction (peduncle area); sparse, low-density white flecking on the upper peripheral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated convergence angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude deviations between 4 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a concave sweep towards the distal pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle attachments) localized on the terminal tip of the left lobe and the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization by sessile barnacles on the peripheral margins and tips; significant serration irregularity on the trailing edge consistent with accumulated environmental wear.
